content.text: TCP is a connection-oriented protocol that establishes a session first and guarantees reliable, ordered delivery of data through acknowledgments and retransmissions. UDP is connectionless and sends packets without any such guarantees, which makes it faster and lighter but means data can arrive out of order, duplicated, or not at all.
